paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: The QA performance, confidence, and alignment of ChatGPT under different question popularity.

annotations.annotation: Die Abbildung ist ein Liniendiagramm und veranschaulicht die Beziehung zwischen der Fragenpopularität und drei verschiedenen erfassten Werten: Genauigkeit, Vertrauen und Ausrichtung. Die horizontale Achse ist beschriftet mit "Question Popularity" und weist eine lineare Skala von 5,0 bis 25,0 auf, mit Teilstrichen im Abstand von 2,5. Die vertikale Achse ist beschriftet mit "Values" und verwendet ebenfalls eine lineare Skala von 0,2 bis 1,0 mit Teilstrichen in Abständen von 0,1. Das Diagramm enthält drei verschieden Linien, die sich in keinem Punkt im Diagramm schneiden. Die blaue Linie mit kreisförmigen Markierungen startet bei 5,0 mit ungefähr 0 und steigt auf einen Wert von 0,7 bei 25,0. Die rote Linie startet bei 5,0 mit ungefähr 0,5 und steigt auf einen Wert von 0,75 bei 25,0. Die grüne Linie startet bei 5,0 mit ungefähr 0,7 und steigt dann auf einen Wert von 0,95 bei 25,0. Eine Legende in der unteren rechten Ecke ordnet jeder Linie die Farbe mit einem Symbol zu. Die blaue Linie ist beschriftet mit "Accuracy", die grüne Linie mit "Confidence" und die rote Linie mit "Alignment".

The plot illustrates the change in accuracy, confidence, and alignment values of ChatGPT on Basketball as related to question popularity. The x-axis is labeled "Question Popularity" and uses a linear scale ranging from 5 to 25 with tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis is labeled "Values," also on a linear scale, ranging from 0.2 to 1.00 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. Three lines are depicted: a blue line with circular markers representing "Accuracy" starts at approximately 0.2 at a question popularity of 5.0 and ends near 0.7 at 25.0, showing a steady upward trend. A green line with triangular markers for "Confidence" begins at around 0.72 at 5.0 and increases to about 0.92 at 25.0, also depicting an upward trend. The red line with square markers denoting "Alignment" starts at around 0.5 and finishes just above 0.75, exhibiting a consistent upward progression. Each line steadily rises without any apparent peaks. A legend is provided on the bottom right of the plot to map different line colors to their labels.

The Y-axis is labeled "Values," also with a linear scale, ranging from 0.2 to 1.0, with ticks at intervals of 0.1 units. Three lines are depicted: a blue line with circular markers representing "Accuracy" starts at slightly above 0.20 at a question popularity of 5.0 and ends near 0.7 at 25.0, showing a steady upward trend. A green line with triangular markers for "Confidence" begins at around 0.725 at 5.0 and increases to about 0.95 at 25.0, also depicting an upward trend. The red line with square markers denoting "Alignment" starts at slightly below 0.5 and finishes at about 0.75, exhibiting a consistent upward progression. Each line steadily rises without any apparent peaks or declines. Even though all three lines rise in the same pattern, there is no intersection between any two lines. A legend is provided on the bottom right corner of the plot to map different line colors to their labels.

Изображението представлява линейна диаграма и онагледява връзката между популярността на въпросите и три различни измерени стойности: точност, увереност и съгласуваност. Хоризонталната ос е обозначена като „Популярност на въпросите“ и използва линейна скала от 5,0 до 25,0 с деления на всеки 2,5. Вертикалната ос е обозначена като „Стойности“ и също използва линейна скала от 0,2 до 1,0 с деления през 0,1. Диаграмата съдържа три различни линии, които не се пресичат в нито една точка. Синята линия с кръгли маркери започва при стойност 0 при 5,0 и се покачва до около 0,7 при 25,0. Червената линия започва при около 0,5 при 5,0 и се покачва до 0,75 при 25,0. Зелената линия започва при около 0,7 при 5,0 и се покачва до 0,95 при 25,0. Легендата в долния десен ъгъл свързва всяка линия с нейния цвят и символ. Синята линия е обозначена като „Точност“ (Accuracy), зелената като „Увереност“ (Confidence), а червената като „Съгласуваност“ (Alignment).
